# Theoretical model

Here we outline a theoretical model to show how mathematics works.

We assume weak separability between consumption and leisure so that the utility a person gets can be expressed as $U(c, \tilde{v}(h_1, \ldots, h_I; \vec{\theta}))$. $\tilde{v}$ is an aggregator over leisure activities and $\vec{\theta} = \{\theta_1, \ldots, \theta_I \}$ is a vector of **quality levels** of the leisure activities.

We assume that leisure is aggregated with the following functional form
$$
\tilde{v}(\vec{h}; \vec{\theta}) = \displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{I} \frac{\left(\theta_i h_i\right)^{1-\frac{1}{\eta_i}}}{1-\frac{1}{\eta_i}}
$$
